rules: Only mandatory R input counted: optional scenes and P examples are not evidence of R exposure.
Role categories are previous proposals, not proof of lexical importance.
Lemma normalization is provisional and cannot disambiguate identical spellings with different meanings; F1 needs separate senses.
No translation, gender, inflection, or Russian reverse search is supplied by this manifest.
Mandatory P-only example lemmas are included separately as F1 candidate lookups; these example strings are not mandatory player word choices.
29 thematic catalogue groups extend beyond the currently authored mandatory scenes; each backticked unit is a F1 candidate entry, not a learner requirement.
Optional scenes and optional P replies are not mandatory learning evidence but must be available in the full F1 of the authored act.
